IMFM.description: Inelastic Material Property for Fiber Model (IMFM). Each key is a material id; which name fields apply depends on the referenced material's type (C: concrete/confined-concrete/rebar, SRC: concrete/rebar, S: steel), and each name must reference an existing Fiber Model (FIMP) property by name.

CONC_NAME.description: [TYPE=C,SRC] Name of the Fiber Model (FIMP) property assigned as the concrete inelastic material. Empty means no assignment.

CONFINED_CONC_NAME.description: [TYPE=C] Name of the Fiber Model (FIMP) property assigned as the confined concrete inelastic material (columns). Empty means no assignment.

REBAR_NAME.description: [TYPE=C,SRC] Name of the Fiber Model (FIMP) property assigned as the rebar inelastic material. Empty means no assignment.

STEEL_NAME.description: [TYPE=S] Name of the Fiber Model (FIMP) property assigned as the steel inelastic material. Empty means no assignment.

manual_title: Inelastic Material Properties for Fiber Model
